column1: Watch one element on a real rendered page.
column2: 监听真实渲染页面中的某个元素。

column1: Stars, issues, comments and releases on one repository.

Interval must be at least 1 second
column2: 检查间隔至少为 1 秒

column1: Sub-15-minute checks run from a foreground service; a one-second cadence uses more battery
column2: 低于 15 分钟的检查由前台服务执行；1 秒间隔会明显增加耗电

column1: A sub-minute interval is held by a foreground service. One second is useful on a LAN endpoint and costs noticeably more battery.
column2: 秒级间隔由前台服务常驻维持。1 秒适合内网接口测试，耗电会明显增加。

column1: This kind of check stays on a minute-scale interval: each run is expensive enough that a one-second cadence would be rate-limited.
column2: 此类监控保持分钟级间隔：每次检查成本较高，1 秒频率会触发限流。
